name: Xia Lü
source:
“Then you just keep moving forward! There’s never only one horizon.”

Zhang Yuanxin’s childhood friend and the Detective Club’s “manager.” A cheerful girl who loves the starry sky, she’s quick to give Yuanxin an earful whenever he fools around. Around Cheng Feng, though, she quickly turns bashful.
